# What is this associate offer actually worth, next to the other one?

> Free dental associate pay calculator. Enter two offers, percent of production or collections, daily guarantee and lab fee share, to see what each pays at your expected production, your effective percentage, and where they cross. Runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
